Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We're not just another startup; we're the rocket fuel propelling the mobile universe to new heights! Backed by 4 international visionary VCs and a multitude of European and US-based angel investors/founders with experience in creating consumer apps, our startup is led by two serial founders whose apps have reached the fingertips of over 3 billion users in the last decade!
 Our team is a tight-knit crew of dreamers, doers, dog lovers (and cat enthusiasts), aggressively expanding the boundaries of what's possible in the mobile space. Joining us means getting in on the ground floor of a hyperscaling startup that's all about innovation, not corporate stagnation. Here, your work speaks louder than words.
 You'll be working on BibleChat ( https://thebiblechat.com/ ) - the fastest-growing Christian app in the world.
 Check out BibleChat's website https://thebiblechat.com together with our company's website: https://soulstream.ai 
 🙏 The Role:
 We're a small product team in Bucharest that moves fast, and we're looking for an engineer who likes owning things from start to finish. It's a startup, not a corporation: no layers of managers, no endless meetings, just a small team building and shipping together.You'll own the tools our team uses every day.
 💡 What You'll Do:
 You'll talk to the people using them, decide what to build next, and ship it. When something isn't working well, you'll find the real cause and make it better for good, not just patch it. Over time, the reliability and quality of these systems will be yours.
 You'll have full ownership of your work, from the first idea to production. What you build gets used right away, and you'll see the impact of what you ship the same day. The work will push you, and it will help you grow to the next level, both as an engineer and as a person.
 What we work with:
 TypeScript, React, Next.js, Supabase (Postgres), cloud hosting and a handful of third-party APIs. We build AI-first: Claude Code and Codex are part of how we work every day, and you'll have full access to them.
 🌟 Requirements:
 You've spent 1 to 3 years building web apps with TypeScript and React
 You're comfortable working with production databases (Supabase is a plus)
 You actually enjoy digging into why something broke
 You already work with AI agents like Claude Code or Codex every day, and know when to trust them and when to double-check
 You can explain things simply to people who aren't engineers
 This role is on-site only, working from our office in Bucharest alongside the rest of the team.
 What you get: a small team where your work is noticed from week one, and the opportunity to learn from some of the best engineers in Romania.
 Interested? Send us a few lines about a bug you tracked down and how you fixed it, plus your GitHub or a project you're proud of.
 🎉 Why Join Us?
 We offer a range of benefits, including a cool office environment, free massages, gym membership, and healthcare benefits. But don't join us just for the perks—join us because we're a team of passionate professionals working hard to build something with a global impact.
 This is a unique opportunity to work closely with our founders and shape a product that feels both familiar and innovative. You'll have the chance to join a startup on the rise, where your work directly influences the lives of millions of users. If you’re looking for a place where creativity is encouraged and results are celebrated, you’ll fit right in.
